stories.title: Over 60 vessels redirected by US military since resumption of blockade of Iran — CENTCOM
stories.summary: Three vessels were disabled and two were boarded to ensure compliance
article_sentences: The US military has redirected 62 commercial vessels since July 14 when the United States resumed its naval blockade against Iran, the US Central Command (CENTCOM) said.
"As of Aug. 14, CENTCOM forces have redirected 62 commercial vessels, disabled 3 and boarded 2 to ensure compliance," it wrote on X.

stories.title: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Aramco facility in Najran
stories.summary: According to the Houthi source, the operation was conducted in response to the violation of the Yemeni sovereignty by Saudi warplanes
article_sentences: The Houthis from the Yemeni rebel movement.
Ansar Allah have attacked a Saudi Aramco facility in the city of Najran, the Houthi-controlled SABA news agency reported.
"The Yemeni armed forces (referring to the Houthis - TASS) have successfully attacked a [Saudi] Aramco facility in Najran with the use of a drone," it cited a Houthi source.

According to the source, the operation was conducted in response to the violation of the Yemeni sovereignty by Saudi warplanes that intruded airspace over the northwestern part of the border province of Saada.
On August 13, the Houthis said they had attacked a Saudi Aramco oil refinery in the city of Jizan.
